content:
Maya: Heads-up — planning a cohorted rate change rollout next Tue 2026-04-07 09:00 PT. Goal: test new tiered rates for orgs with >100k tokens/month. Need canary, billing changes, grandfathering rules, and legal signoff.

Samir: Proposed cohorts: canary = 2% low-risk (<$5k MRR) + internal test accounts; ramp 20% after 48h if no regressions. How strict do we want token-count vs MRR splitting?

Jess: I'll own the billing migration + feature flag. Checklist I'm adding:
- Create `rate_change_v2` flag
- Migration script to attach `grandfathered:true` to existing subs opting-in
- Update invoice rendering template
- Run dry-run against staging invoices

Oliver: Legal: need copy for grandfathering opt-in/opt-out + refund window. Also qc on T&Cs. Please tag me when copy is ready.

billing-bot: System: invoice-scan found 7 recurring subs with proration edge-cases (monthly->annual). Details:
````
sub_1023, mrr: $120, next_invoice: 2026-04-15, note: proration_override:true
sub_1145, mrr: $480, next_invoice: 2026-04-20, note: trial_end_mismatch
````

Samir: For canary selection SQL (staging):
```
SELECT id FROM customers
WHERE active=true AND mrr < 5000
ORDER BY rand()
LIMIT 100
```
Will add segmentation by last-30d usage.

Maya: Notification strategy: email + in-console banner 7 days before change. @product-ops to approve copy. Also need CS playbook for inbound billing questions.

Jess: Ops checklist (short):
- Feature flag deploy (eng)
- Migration run (billing team)
- Verify invoices in staging (qa)
- Monitor Refund/chargeback rate (finance)
- Migrate production at 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% (24-48h gates)

Oliver: Approvals needed: Product, Legal, CS, Finance lead (Samir). Can we get signoffs by Fri EOD?

Maya: @samir @jess please drop the final migration script & runbook here. I'll assemble a short risk register.

Samir: Dropping runbook in /docs/internal/pricing-rollouts and tagging here once done. :thumbsup:

Jess: Added runbook link: https://redwood.internal/pricing/rollouts/1775 - walk-through scheduled Wed 10am PT. Invite sent to @oliver @maya @samir.

billing-bot: Alert: staging dry-run produced 2 invoices with mixed currency conversions — flagged for manual review.

Maya: Thanks team. If no major blockers in the Wed walk-through, we aim for canary Tue. I'll post final go/no-go by Mon 5pm PT. :rocket:
